# www.fmind.dev

> Freelance AI/ML Architect & Engineer specialized in AI Agents and MLOps.

## AI Agent Access

- **MCP server** (Model Context Protocol, Streamable HTTP): `https://www.fmind.dev/mcp` — read-only tools `get_profile`, `list_experience`, `list_certifications`, `list_publications`, `list_projects`, `get_services`, and a `portfolio://profile.json` resource. Add it as a custom connector in Claude or ChatGPT.
- **JSON snapshot**: `https://www.fmind.dev/api/profile` — the full portfolio (profile, experience, certifications, publications, projects, services) as a single JSON document.

## Bio

Médéric Hurier (Fmind) is a Freelance AI/ML Architect & Engineer with a PhD in AI and Computer Security from the University of Luxembourg. He specializes in designing autonomous agentic workflows and production-ready MLOps environments, transforming AI/ML initiatives into structured, secure, and scalable architectures for enterprise production.

## Services

- **Freelancing**: Available for consulting, designing, and building enterprise-scale AI Agents and MLOps platforms.
- **Mentoring**: Paid 1-hour sessions for architecture reviews, career mentoring, upskilling, and project brainstorming.

## Top Open Source Projects

- **mlops-python-package**: A flexible, robust, and productive Python package template to kickstart MLOps initiatives.
- **cookiecutter-mlops-package**: A Cookiecutter template for building and deploying Python packages and Docker images for MLOps.
- **MLOps Coding Course**: A comprehensive course teaching software engineering best practices applied to data science and MLOps.

## Content & Media

- **Bleeding Agent**: A technical podcast/series diving deep into AI Agents and autonomous systems.
- **AI Agents in a Nut$HELL**: High-signal, bite-sized explanations of AI Agent architectures.
- **MLOps Coding Course (YouTube)**: Video lectures bridging software engineering and machine learning.
